August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 274)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on August 28 across American network radio, three landmark Meet the Press interviews (1955 Soviet agriculture with Dr. W.V. Lambert, 1960 Eisenhower HEW Secretary Arthur Flemming, and 1966 AFL-CIO President George Meany), Irna Phillips' The Guiding Light for Ivory Soap, Bob Trout & William L. Shirer reporting on the Axis Vienna pact, and Kirk Douglas swashbuckling as Renaissance artist Benvenuto Cellini on The Prudential Family Hour of Stars (1940–1966):
